prompt: RimWorld game animal sprite: the blinker, a hydrocarbon animal of the Lantern Deeps. A prey animal built around one organ. Its rest state is dim, shuttered by that arm; its alarm state, drawn as a second sprite frame or a mote, is the arm flung wide and the whole body white-blue, the yellow bleached out. House palette, with the flash as a pure overexposed burst.
